original_task:
A mid-sized e-commerce company wants to implement AI-powered customer service to reduce support costs and improve response times. They currently handle 10,000 support tickets per month with a team of 15 agents.

Provide recommendations considering:
- Available AI/chatbot solutions
- Expected cost savings vs implementation costs
- Impact on customer experience
- Implementation timeline and risks
- Training requirements for existing staff
